```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(glue)
library(fs)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r split-by-cohort}
all_study_mris <- read.csv(here("data/raw", "mris_for_converter_analysis.csv"))
```

For brainage prediction using brainageR we used the script:
`./scripts/brainageR_predictions.sh -c data/tmp/study_index_files/{COHORT}.csv -o /{project_root}/brainageR_predictions`

```{r load-data}
existing_mris_data <- read.csv(here("data/raw", "mris_for_converter_analysis.csv"))

brainager_predictions_path <- file.path(conf$project_data_path, "brainageR_predictions")
tissue_volume_csvs <- dir_ls(brainager_predictions_path, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*_tissue_volumes.csv")
brainage_prediction_csvs <- dir_ls(brainager_predictions_path, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*_brainage.csv")
```

```{r transform-brainage-data}
brainage_prediction_cache_path <- here("data/tmp", "brainage_predictions.csv")

if (file.exists(brainage_prediction_cache_path)) {
    # --- Load Cached Data ---
    message("Found cached data. Loading from: ", brainage_prediction_cache_path)
    brainage_predictions <- read_csv(brainage_prediction_cache_path, col_types = cols())
    
} else {
    brainage_predictions <- brainage_prediction_csvs %>% 
        set_names() %>% 
        map_df(~read_csv(.x, col_types = cols()), .id = "file_path") %>%
        mutate(composite_key = str_extract(file_path, glue("(?<={brainager_predictions_path}/)[^/]+"))) %>%
        separate_wider_delim(
            cols = composite_key,
            delim = "_",
            names = c("cohort", "assessment", "subject_id"),
            too_many = "merge"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
            assessment = as.integer(assessment),
            subject_id = if_else(cohort == "macs", str_pad(subject_id, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"), subject_id)
        ) %>%
        select(-file_path, -File)

    if (!dir.exists(here("data/tmp"))) dir.create(here("data/tmp"))
    write_csv(brainage_predictions, brainage_prediction_cache_path)
}

```
```{r transform-tissue-data}
tissue_cache_path <- here("data/tmp", "tissue_volumes.csv")

if (file.exists(tissue_cache_path)) {
    # --- Load Cached Data ---
    message("Found cached data. Loading from: ", tissue_cache_path)
    tissue_volumes <- read_csv(tissue_cache_path, col_types = cols())
    
} else {
    tissue_volumes <- tissue_volume_csvs %>% 
        set_names() %>% 
        map_df(~read_csv(.x, col_types = cols()), .id = "file_path") %>%
        mutate(composite_key = str_extract(file_path, glue("(?<={brainager_predictions_path}/)[^/]+"))) %>%
        separate_wider_delim(
            cols = composite_key,
            delim = "_",
            names = c("cohort", "assessment", "subject_id"),
            too_many = "merge"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
            assessment = as.integer(assessment),
            subject_id = if_else(cohort == "macs", str_pad(subject_id, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"), subject_id)
        ) %>%
        # Total Gray Matter volume, Total White Matter volume, Total CSF volume
        rename(gmv = Volume1, wmv = Volume2, csf = Volume3) %>%
        select(-file_path, -File)

    # Create tmp directory if it doesn't exist
    if (!dir.exists(here("data/tmp"))) dir.create(here("data/tmp"))
    
    # write to cache dir
    write_csv(tissue_volumes, tissue_cache_path)
}

colnames(tissue_volumes)
```

```{r merge-data}
merged_df <- existing_mris_data %>%
  left_join(brainage_predictions, by = c("cohort", "assessment", "subject_id")) %>%
  left_join(tissue_volumes, by = c("cohort", "assessment", "subject_id")) %>% 
  select(cohort, subject_id, assessment, everything(), -file_name, -image_path)
write.csv(merged_df, file=here("data/processed/brainage_for_analysis.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
